verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers explicitly supports cron triggers, durable Workflows, and Queues for scheduling recurring jobs (cloudflare-docs-9), which directly satisfies the automation-depth story. However, community feedback notes CPU-time limits (30s free / 15min paid) make it unsuitable for long-running AI agent workloads, a significant caveat for AI-native recurring automation (cloudflare-comm-9). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of cron/Workflows specifically for AI agent scheduling, and no evidence addressing the long-running-task limitation being resolved.
